svg.text: Otto V9 · EPLZON perfboard connector map
TOP / COMPONENT SIDE · letters upright · board drawing is not to scale
4×AA → switch/protection → 5 V buck-boost ≥3 A → insulated star → 4 servo power branches.
Nano GND joins star. Regulated +5 V → removable RUN plug → Nano 5V; unplug USB in RUN mode.
Before USB: disconnect AA pack and RUN plug. Copper strips are local only; meter-test each row.
